name: Ground Chicken Wrap with Sautéed Bell Peppers & Apple-Cilantro Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 yellow bell peppers
1 ½ lemons
6 Granny Smith apples
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers, chicken, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and coarsely grate apples. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the slaw; set aside.
When the chicken is done, place tortillas on a flat surface, then divide chicken and peppers between them. Top with apple slaw, roll tightly to close, and cut in half.
To serve, divide chicken wraps between plates and enjoy!
